info.title: Pharos CLI - Headless test execution and migration tools
info.description: The pharos command: smoke-test a Vintage Story mod (boot, join, play, fail on errors), run benchmarks, migrate Atlas suites. Uses your own Vintage Story install; ships none of the game's files.

commands.name: benchmark
commands.description: Run performance benchmarks and check for regressions

options.name: --baseline-file
options.description: Path to baselines JSON file

options.name: --update-baselines
options.description: Run benchmarks and update the baselines file

options.name: --fail-on-regression
options.description: Exit with code 3 if any benchmark exceeds threshold

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report results without failing or writing files

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two test runs (TRX files) and gate on regressions

options.name: --slower-than
options.description: Report passing tests that took more than this much longer (default: 50%)

options.name: --min-delta
options.description: ... and at least this many seconds longer (default: 1)

options.name: --fail-on-slower
options.description: Count slower tests as regressions

options.name: --fail-on-vanished
options.description: Count tests that are gone from the second run as regressions

options.name: --fail-on-skipped
options.description: Count tests skipped in the second run, and run before, as regressions

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the comparison as JSON

commands.name: fixture
commands.description: Run a builder scenario and save the world it leaves

options.name: --scenario
options.description:
The test that builds the world: Namespace.Class.Method, or any
dotted tail of it (Class.Method) that names one test

options.name: --out
options.description: Where to write the save; replaced only when the run succeeds

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Use the project's last build

options.name: --game
options.description: Vintage Story install (else VINTAGE_STORY)

options.name: --xvfb
options.description: Run the test under xvfb-run (default: auto, on Linux without a display)

options.name: --test-timeout
options.description: Stop the test after this long (default: 30)

options.name: --results-dir
options.description: Where the run's results and logs go (default: pharos-fixture)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the test's output

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help for a specific command

commands.name: migrate-atlas
commands.description: Migrate Atlas test suites to Pharos

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview changes without modifying files

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress

options.name: --backup
options.description: Create .bak files before modifying (default)

options.name: --no-backup
options.description:
Don't create backup files
What it changes:
- Package references: Pixnop.Atlas → Zaldaryon.Pharos.XUnit
- Using statements: Atlas.Api → Zaldaryon.Pharos.Server
- Type references: IWorldSession → EmbeddedServerHost, etc.
- Attributes: [AtlasScenario] → [ServerScenario], etc.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a test assembly's classes in parallel worker processes

options.name: --filter
options.description: A dotnet test filter, e.g. "Category=Live"

options.name: --parallel
options.description:
How many workers run at once (default: 1)
--group class|collection How tests are split between workers (default: class)

options.name: --list
options.description: List the groups and their tests; run nothing

options.name: --trx
options.description: Where the merged TRX goes (default: <results-dir>/pharos.trx)

options.name: --results-dir
options.description: Worker logs, TRX files and failure artifacts (default: pharos-run)

options.name: --test-timeout
options.description:
Stop a test host whose test runs longer, keeping the results
so far (default: 30, scaled by PHAROS_TIMEOUT_SCALE)

options.name: --worker-timeout
options.description:
Stop a worker after this many minutes (default: 60,
scaled by PHAROS_TIMEOUT_SCALE)

options.name: --game
options.description: The Vintage Story install workers use (default: VINTAGE_STORY)

options.name: --json
options.description: Write JSON lines to standard output instead of text

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration of a project (default: Release)

options.name: --no-build
options.description:
Use a project's last build
--xvfb auto|always|never Give each worker its own virtual display (default: auto,
on Linux without a display when xvfb-run is installed)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Print each worker's command
Tests in Category=Live get a worker per class (or collection); all other tests share one.
Each worker is a `dotnet vstest` process. A worker that crashes or hangs fails its group
and the tests it did not report; it never hangs the run.
Exit codes: 0 all passed, 1 a test failed, 2 an error before the tests ran.

commands.name: smoke
commands.description: Boot, join and play with a mod, failing on errors

options.name: --mod
options.description: A mod to load: a folder, a .zip or a .dll (repeatable, required)

options.name: --frames
options.description: Frames to play, the server ticking once per frame (default: 600)

options.name: --command
options.description: A server console command to run after the join (repeatable)

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail on any warning logged while booting

options.name: --allow
options.description: A boot warning to allow with --strict (repeatable)

options.name: --allow-error
options.description: A fragment of a logged error to allow (repeatable)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: How long the play may take (default: 300; scaled by PHAROS_TIMEOUT_SCALE)

options.name: --artifacts
options.description: Where failure artifacts go (default: $PHAROS_ARTIFACTS or ./pharos-artifacts)

options.name: --game
options.description: The Vintage Story install (default: $VINTAGE_STORY)

options.name: --seed
options.description: The world seed

options.name: --world-type
options.description: The world type (default: superflat)

options.name: --play-style
options.description: The play style (default: creativebuilding)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show the game's own output instead of writing it to smoke.log

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Exit codes:
0 - The smoke test passed
1 - The smoke test failed: see the message and the artifacts
2 - Bad arguments or environment (no game install, no display, a missing mod)

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the test assembly

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter tests by name (case-insensitive contains)

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Directory for test output files

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output

options.name: --max-parallel
options.description: Maximum parallel test execution (default: 1)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Exit codes:
0 - All tests passed (or successful operation)
1 - One or more tests failed
2 - Error occurred (invalid arguments, assembly not found, etc.)
3 - Benchmark regression detected
